text:
Goodbye Solo (2008) – Good, but Overrated
12,088 – 26 Nov 2025
In North Caroline, the Senegalese taxi driver Solo (Souléymane Sy Savané) is a communicative and happy man that lives with the Latin Quiera (Carmen Leyva) and her daughter Alex (Diana Franco Galindo). When he meets the old man William (Red West) in his cab, he hires Alex to drive him to Blowing Rock, a place where there are strong winds, two weeks later on the 20th. Solo finds the request strange since the man does not schedule return and has just sold his apartment. The man asks to go to a motel, but drinks with Solo first and they go to his home. On the next morning, William learns that Solo is studying to be flight attendant against the will of Quiera. Along the days, Solo befriends William and tries to understand his motive for suicide.
“Goodbye Solo” (2008) is a good but overrated American drama by Ramin Bahrani. Very well acted, the plot keeps the mystery about the reasons why William wants to commit suicide. His notebook snooped by Solo gives a subtle explanation os William’s motive and the conclusion is open, ambiguous and not clear whether William ended his life. My vote is six.
